Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “younger director” by comparing the directors’ ages at the time of their respective films’ releases instead of comparing their birth dates. With DOBs Reginald Le Borg (1902) and Hervé Bromberger (1918), Bromberger is the younger director, so the correct film should be Figaro-ci, Figaro-la. The Planner’s release-age comparison led to the wrong conclusion (Joe Palooka in Fighting Mad).
